slots.role: Hook: the whole promise as a single short line, assembled on screen
slots.visualRecipe: Near-white ground (#FEFEFE). A single centred line in a semibold neo-grotesque, line box about 9% of frame height, about 78% of width when complete. Four small ink dots about 4% outside the corners of the line's box. End state: the line complete, its two phrases pushed about 5% apart.
slots.motionRecipe: A word appears whole each 10 frames; each arrives pale, turns a saturated warm hue, then a contrasting cool hue, and settles to ink about 5 frames after appearing; the line recentres on each arrival and the corner dots spread to the new corners over 5-8 frames. Frames 54-59: open the gap between the phrases. Exit: hard cut on frame 60.
slots.soundRecipe: Unknown in the reference (cannot hear). Suggested: a soft tick per word arrival, under a quiet bed; nothing measured ties the arrivals to the beat.

copySlot.purpose: The offer stated as cause and result, in two short phrases

slots.role: Context: the world before the offer, entered through a collapsing dark card
slots.visualRecipe: Frame-filling photographic landscape plate in natural late light. A soft-edged black rounded card about 92% x 85% of the frame on the first frame. End state: a row of small rounded tool icons floating at about 43% height with a thin white underline under the first.
slots.motionRecipe: Card shrinks over 12 frames, power3.out, into the underline's rect; icons fade in around it from frame 10 of the shot. Slow drift of the row to the left begins. Exit: hard cut to a closer framing.
slots.soundRecipe: Unknown (cannot hear). A low swell under the card collapse would suit; inferred, not measured.

slots.role: The familiar tools pass by, the selection lands on the offer's mark
slots.visualRecipe: Same plate about 1.9x closer, strongly defocused; the icon row sharp, icons about 5% of frame width, 13% apart, neutral tool glyphs (never real third-party icons). The last icon is the offer's mark in solid ink. End state: other icons blurred, the mark sharp at the right third.
slots.motionRecipe: Constant-speed slide left (linear) for about 2.4 s, the underline passing along; on arrival the other icons blur over 5 frames. Exit: a soft-edged dark disc grows from the lower-left corner over 10 frames, sine.inOut, sparing the mark, which stays on top.
slots.soundRecipe: Unknown (cannot hear). Suggested: a single rising whoosh under the disc; inferred.

slots.role: Name, first and quiet: the only dark ground
slots.visualRecipe: Ground #0D0D15. The mark, white-outlined, centred at about 45% height; under it the name in tracked capitals about 2.5% of frame height.
slots.motionRecipe: Name types a letter each 2-3 frames; the mark pulses about 5% larger over the last 5 frames. Exit: hard cut to white.
slots.soundRecipe: Unknown (cannot hear). Suggested: drop the bed's high end while dark; inferred.

slots.visualRecipe: White ground. A single word, regular weight, line box about 12% of frame height, settling to a mid purple (#884295-like) at centre.
slots.motionRecipe: Enters from below on an upward-curving baseline and straightens while rising to centre in 9 frames, power2.out; holds with a slow shrink and a 2-frame snap smaller just before the exit. Exit: hard cut.

copySlot.purpose: A word that announces something new

slots.role: Mark and wordmark lockup, then the mark detaches
slots.visualRecipe: White ground. Mark at about 11% of frame width on entry, about 6% in the lockup; wordmark in medium sans beside it; lockup about 33% of width, centred. End state: the mark alone at top centre (0.5, 0.2), about 4% of width.
slots.motionRecipe: Mark cuts in large, shrinks in 3 frames while the wordmark slides out from behind it in 6 frames, power3.out; slow push-in. Then the mark tumbles a quarter turn and rises (11 frames) while the wordmark exits right, accelerating. Hold 16 frames.

slots.role: Proof begins: the real interface opens around the mark
slots.visualRecipe: A circle about 45% of frame width around the mark opens to the real interface's input screen on a pastel violet-pink gradient ground with a faint square grid; the mark becomes the screen's header at the same position. Input card about 55% of frame width, centred at 55% height.
slots.motionRecipe: Circle opens past the frame in 6 frames, expo.out (shapeWipe from the mark's position). The request is keyed into the field at the interface's real speed. Exit: a single frame of blur, then a hard punch-in.
slots.soundRecipe: Unknown (cannot hear). Suggested: soft keystrokes; inferred.

copySlot.purpose: A realistic request a customer would enter

slots.role: Make the request legible and send it
slots.visualRecipe: About 2.6x on the input field, cropped off the left edge (field from x 0 to 0.64) so its words are about 7% of frame height; header words cropped at the top-left. A cursor arrow about 5% of frame height.
slots.motionRecipe: Sharpen over 2 frames after the cut; typing finishes; cursor enters bottom right and travels to the send button; on the press the button flips accent colour; slow pull-out for 6 frames. Exit: hard cut.
slots.soundRecipe: Unknown (cannot hear). Suggested: a click on the press frame; inferred.

slots.role: The work happening: a checklist of what the offer does
slots.visualRecipe: White ground, the real interface's thread view: the request as a right-aligned grey bubble at the top right, a status line with spinner, then up to six rows left-aligned at x 0.06-0.08, each about 4.5% of frame height with a spinner or tick.
slots.motionRecipe: Bubble slides up into place; status appears after 5 frames; rows append at gaps of 6-17 frames, each tinted then settling, spinner turning to a tick; the list scrolls so the newest row sits in the lower middle; the last two stay pending. Exit: hard cut.

copySlot.purpose: Each row names a step the offer performs, as a gerund phrase

slots.role: The result on a real device
slots.visualRecipe: White ground; a 3D handset with a black bezel, tilted about 20 degrees clockwise, filling the frame height, cropped at the bottom, its screen showing the real result.
slots.motionRecipe: Pull out about 29% with a further 11 degrees clockwise roll over 1.14 s, circ.out, then drift. Exit: hard cut.

slots.role: Range: many outcomes orbit a single claim
slots.visualRecipe: White ground; about 30 rounded photo cards (7-9% of width, soft shadows) on a tilted ellipse about 70% x 85% of the frame around a centred short line (line box about 5.6% of height).
slots.motionRecipe: Ring contracts into place from beyond the frame and orbits at constant speed; the line is keyed word by word. Exit: ring expands off all edges in 12 frames, power2.in, leaving the line alone for a frame, then a hard cut.

copySlot.purpose: Breadth of what the offer covers

slots.visualRecipe: White ground; headline in medium sans, ink, about 84% of frame width at 37-50% height; a grey (#666666) sub-line under it about 64% wide; four small coloured pills floating off the corners.
slots.motionRecipe: Headline cuts in whole; the sub-line is keyed with a thin caret over about 1.9 s; pills drift a few pixels. Exit: the block rolls clockwise and scales up over 11 frames, power2.in, into a hard cut.

copySlot.purpose: Headline: the benefit; sub-line: the contrast with the old way

slots.role: Brand and call to action, held
slots.visualRecipe: White ground. Mark enters at about 27% of frame height, rotated about 20 degrees, settling square at about 7% of width; wordmark beside it; lockup about 31% of width, centred. Below: dark #333333 pill button 19% of width at 64% height and a small grey address at 73%.
slots.motionRecipe: Mark unrotates and shrinks, expo.out, about 1.5 s. Wordmark types a letter each 3 frames with tint settle, lockup recentring. Button and address fade and rise over 8 frames. Still hold for the last 2.2 s; no fade on the final frame.
slots.soundRecipe: Silence for the last 0.83 s (measured in the reference). What precedes it is unknown (cannot hear).

copySlot.purpose: Action label on the button and the address

rhythm.cutGrid: No beat grid: the reference's tempo is low confidence and its cuts land on beats, onsets and loudness swells at about chance. The clock is the animation: words each 10 frames, letters each 2-3 frames, rows each 6-17 frames. 13 shots, 12 boundaries (10 hard cuts, 2 circle wipes), median shot 2.0 s; fastest in the name section (three shots of 1.07-1.6 s), longest at the end (5.6 s).

style: Clean white release film: a single neo-grotesque sans in ink on near-white, colour used only as an arrival tint on new words and a few accents; a single dark shot, a single photographic plate, a single pastel interface ground. Something is always being written or carried, and the mark persists across boundaries.

keep: Words, letters and rows arrive whole and tinted, then settle to ink in about 5 frames
The opening states the promise in a single assembled line before any name or mark
A single persistent element (the mark) carried across most boundaries: spared by the iris, landing in the lockup, becoming the interface header, returning at the end
Each section owns its ground: white, photographic, dark, white, pastel interface, white
Real interface proof in the middle: key in the request, punch in to legibility, press, wait through a checklist
Transitions continue movement across the cut (collapse into an element, iris around the mark, ring expanding out, roll into a spinning mark)
Timing from the animation clock, not a beat grid
Still end card with a silent final 0.8 s; no fade on the final frame
mustChange: All branding: name, mark, wordmark, address, colours tied to the brand
All score and audio: a new bed and new cues
All graphics: the landscape plate, tool icons (never real third-party icons), thumbnails, device model, interface captures of the new offer
All copy: each on-screen line, request, checklist row, chip label and button label
The specific example request and the result shown on the device
